name: cache-pulse
description: Prompt-cache status for Claude Code: a countdown above the prompt (and in the terminal footer), the tokens at stake and what a cold restart costs, cache breaks with what was measured and what the request shows changed, session cache totals, a Keep warm button with an optional capped auto-warm, and an expiry warning.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt-cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto: the TTL the API reports for the session's cache writes (1h on a subscription, 5m on the API or in usage overage). 1h or 5m pins it.

cacheWarning.title: Warn before the cache expires
cacheWarning.description: A toast 5 minutes before a 1h cache expires (1 minute for 5m), and a notification through your terminal's notification channel where there is one. With keepWarm auto, only once the auto-warm cap is reached or an auto-warm fails.

keepWarm.title: Keep the cache warm
keepWarm.description: button: a Keep warm button in the band. auto: warm by itself before expiry, up to keepWarmMax times in a row without a prompt from you. Each warm is one cache read of the whole context and counts toward your usage limits.

keepWarmMax.title: Auto-warm cap
keepWarmMax.description: How many auto-warms in a row, with no prompt from you in between, before it stops and notifies you.
